design_vibe: Bold cohesive art direction pushed to the edge, highly editorial, organic yet structural, Awwwards Site-of-the-Day ambition. Premium, purposeful motion. No AI-slop.

headings.usage: Hero headers, section titles, manifesto chapters. Use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter. For .js/.jsx usage.

body.usage: Descriptions, paragraphs, general text. leading-relaxed. Use .js/.jsx conventions.

mono.usage: Overlines, labels, prices, stats (4.6 rating), small technical details. Use uppercase and tracking-[0.2em].

background.description: Warm, flour-like off-white. The dominant canvas.

foreground.description: Deep espresso/soft black for primary text. Never use pure black.

accent.description: Terracotta / Crust brown. Use for buttons, active states, key highlights.

motion: Lenis smooth scrolling (@studio-freight/react-lenis) is MANDATORY for premium weight and momentum.
Framer Motion (framer-motion) for all scroll reveals. useScroll and useTransform for parallax on hero images.
Masked line-by-line reveal for Hero Text: Text lines hidden initially via overflow-hidden, sliding up into view with a stagger.
textures: Subtle noise overlay (SVG filter or CSS background) fixed over the entire site with pointer-events-none to remove digital flatness.
shadows: Avoid soft default Tailwind shadows. Use crisp 1px borders or deep, deliberate organic shadows.

layouts.header: Sticky navigation, crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F4F1EB]/80). CRITICAL: Do not use fully transparent. Logo on left, menu on right.
layouts.hero: Massive kinetic typography taking up 70% of the viewport. Signature masked reveal. A clipped rectangular image that has a slow internal scale parallax on scroll.
layouts.marquee: The 'Editorial Ribbon'. Slow drift using react-fast-marquee. Pale background, Serif font, massive gaps (gap-24). Text: 'FRESHLY BAKED DAILY ✦ VIETNAMESE INSPIRED ✦ CRAIGIEBURN'S FINEST ✦ '
layouts.manifesto: Numbered chapters (01. The Crust, 02. The Craft). 2-column layout. Left column (number + title) is sticky, right column (imagery + text) scrolls.
layouts.menu: Stark editorial list for Banh Mi/Rolls, Bakery/Pastry, Desserts, Drinks. Left-aligned item name (Playfair) and description (Manrope), dotted flex-grow spacer, right-aligned price (JetBrains Mono).
layouts.reviews: Color inversion section. Background dark (#1A1A1A), text light (#F4F1EB). Huge typography quote, big stars (4.6/5.0).
layouts.location: Brutalist grid. Left: Location image/map. Right: Address (300-332 Grand Blvd, Shop 15, Craigieburn, Victoria 3064) and hours in large legible mono/sans typography.
layouts.footer: Massive typography taking up 100% width 'THE FLYING LOAF'. Contact info below.

component_instructions: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for marketing structure. Do NOT use Shadcn cards or generic wrappers.
Do not center-align paragraphs. Use optical alignment.
Write components in .jsx or .js as per the tech stack.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.

accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='menu-category-banh-mi').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast or uses gradient overlays.

hero_artisan.description: Architectural bakery interior / Baker. Use for the subtle parallax hero moment.

banh_mi.description: Premium close-up of a Banh Mi sandwich. Use in the Menu or Manifesto.

pastries.description: Baked treats on tray, warm and artisanal. Use in the Manifesto or Menu.

drinks_coffee.description: Elegant Vietnamese iced coffee. Use in Drinks section.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
NEVER use placeholder URLs or text for images.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
